title.justification: The title reflects the focus of the paper on developing a general-purpose model-free reinforcement learning algorithm as opposed to domain-specific or model-based methods.
title.quote: In this paper, we attempt to find a unifying model-free deep RL algorithm that can address a diverse class of domains and problem settings.

analysis.description: The paper presents MR.Q, a model-free reinforcement learning algorithm designed to work across multiple benchmarks and environments with a single set of hyperparameters. It emphasizes the use of model-based representations to achieve competitive performance similar to model-based methods, without their computational overhead. The algorithm is evaluated on common RL benchmarks, demonstrating its applicability and effectiveness.

type.justification: The paper conducts experiments to evaluate the MR.Q algorithm across various benchmarks and compares it against existing methods, indicating an empirical approach.
type.quote: We evaluate our algorithm, MR.Q, on a variety of common RL benchmarks with a single set of hyperparameters and show a competitive performance against domain-specific and general baselines.
